description: Czech VAT compliance tools. Check unreliable VAT payers (nespolehlivý plátce DPH), registered bank accounts, company lookup via ARES, and EU VAT validation via VIES. Essential for Czech/Slovak businesses to avoid VAT liability under §109 ZDPH.

detail.description: Czech VAT compliance tools. Check unreliable VAT payers (nespolehlivý plátce DPH), registered bank accounts, company lookup via ARES, and EU VAT validation via VIES. Essential for Czech/Slovak businesses to avoid VAT liability under §109 ZDPH.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Look up a Czech company in the ARES registry by IČO (company ID). Returns name, address, VAT number, legal form and status.

tools.name: check_unreliable_vat_payer
tools.description: Check if a Czech company is listed as an 'unreliable VAT payer' (nespolehlivý plátce DPH). If you pay such a supplier, you become jointly liable for their unpaid VAT under §109 ZDPH.

dic.description: Czech VAT number including CZ prefix, e.g. 'CZ27082440'

tools.name: check_bank_accounts
tools.description: Get the registered bank accounts of a Czech VAT payer. Payments to unregistered accounts create VAT liability under §109 ZDPH.

dic.description: Czech VAT number including CZ prefix, e.g. 'CZ27082440'

tools.name: validate_vat_eu
tools.description: Validate any EU VAT number via the official VIES system. Works for all EU member states: CZ, SK, DE, PL, AT, etc.

vat_number.description: VAT number WITHOUT country prefix, e.g. '27082440' (not 'CZ27082440')
